annotations.title: Build a layout from an article

description: Turn an article (kicker, title, lead, paragraphs, source, optional image) and a title profile into the layout description of an opening page (Aufmacherseite): head frame with kicker and title, image or grey placeholder, a multi-column text frame down to the bottom of the type area. All measures and style names come from the profile – type_area_mm {x, width, bottom}, grid_line_mm, head_frame_mm {y, height}, image_top_mm, image_text_gap_lines, columns, gutter_pt, styles {kicker, title, lead, subhead, body, source}, optional paragraph_local {role: {attribute: value}}, placeholder {fill, tint}, empty_line_between_paragraphs, default_image_lines, page_size_mm, text_object_style, image_object_style. Article: title, kicker, lead, paragraphs [[role, text]] (role body or subhead), source, image_lines, image (file path, filled into the frame; image_focus [x, y] 0–1). Returns layout (for build_snippet or build_issue), characters, paragraphs and text_frame_mm. With output_path the layout is written as JSON; with place_on_page_id it is built as snippet and placed like build_snippet does. The line breaks are only known after placing: check overset in the answer.

article_path.description: Path of a .json file with the article, instead of article.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used.

layer.description: Layer (Ebene) for the placed objects. Default: the active layer.

output_path.description: Write the layout description to this .json file.

place_on_page_id.description: Build a snippet and place it on this page right away.

profile_path.description: Path of a .json file with the title profile, instead of profile.

name: build_article
